configPath.description: Where Oxidized stores its archive on this ActiveGate. Three shapes all work: a plain directory of config files (file backend); a Git checkout; or — the shape Oxidized's own git output backend produces, and the one the deployment guide recommends — a BARE repository such as /var/lib/oxidized/configs.git, which has no files on disk and stores each device as a blob named after the node. Git-backed paths also enable drift.

remoteUrl.description: LEAVE BLANK when Oxidized runs on this ActiveGate — the path above is then used directly. Set it when the archive lives elsewhere (GitLab, GitHub Enterprise, Bitbucket, or any Git host Oxidized pushes to with its githubrepo hook): the ActiveGate clones its own mirror and refreshes it every poll, so no NFS export or shared filesystem is needed. HTTPS only, e.g. https://gitlab.example.com/net/oxidized.git — put the username in the URL if the host needs one (https://oauth2@... for GitLab, https://x-token-auth@... for Bitbucket). SSH URLs are not supported; use the path above for an ssh-only remote.

remoteToken.description: Read access to the remote repository above. Leave blank for an unauthenticated remote. Sent as an HTTPS Authorization header, never written to disk and never placed on a command line. Do not paste it into the URL.

goldenRef.description: Git ref/tag of the approved baseline. Requires the path to be a Git repo. Drift is skipped if absent.

deviceGlob.description: LEAVE BLANK to auto-discover every device in the archive — required for Oxidized's git backend, which names each blob after the node with NO file extension, so a pattern like '*.cfg' matches nothing. Set a pattern only to narrow a plain directory: '*.cfg', or '*/*.cfg' when Oxidized 'groups:' is configured.
